name: BASMAH
mission: When you brighten a life, you ignite change that extends far beyond one person. Each individual touched goes on to inspire and uplift those around them, creating a ripple effect of hope and transformation. At BASMAH, we are committed to brightening as many lives as possible—because every life changed brings the world one step closer to a brighter future.
theoryOfChange: The right kind of change happens when people are empowered. Our vision is to empower people and enable them to help themselves and their communities. Short-term help is needed but long-term stability is the goal. Basmah Foundation doesn’t only bring relief to these people in need. We bring them a solution. Our projects are developed with hope of long-term growth for communities all over Bangladesh so they can become self-sufficient.
scoreSummary: BASMAH shows strong alignment and moderate impact, with zakat compliance (minor risk deductions applied).
zakatClaimEvidence: BASMAH is a registered 501(c)(3) non-profit charity organization based in the USA. "Giving your Zakat through Basmah, not only allows you to fulfil your Islamic obligation, but it also means you support our vital work in tackling poverty worldwide." "In line with Islamic principles, BASMAH ensures that Zakat contributions meet Sharia guidelines—distributed only to eligible recipients, without undue delay." "Online and offline donation pages clearly distinguish Zakat, Sadaqah, and Qurbani giving options." "At Basmah, ALL of our programs are zakat-eligible." "Basmah USA allocates your Zakat to support vulnerable communities across the United States through its six key programs, helping those in need locally." "Unlike other non-profits, Basmah USA uses your Zakat to help the vulnerable communities here within the United States!" (Source: https://basmah.org/ramadan/)
